story.head: The Canucks can’t afford to take penalties
paras: The Red Wings won the teams’ first meeting this season, 5-2 in Vancouver on Oct 22. The Canucks (5-18-1) lost 5-1 to Seattle on Thursday, and the Red Wings (8-11-3) lost 4-1 to Boston on Nov 18. Going in, the Canucks are last in the NHL and the Red Wings seventh in the Atlantic (tied for 26th in the NHL).

The Canucks haven’t played well, but their record (.229) is worse than their play: their chances are worth about .323, mostly because they’re 3-5 in one-goal games. The Red Wings have played better than their record (.432) says: their chances are worth about .542, and their finishing has held them back.
This season, the Red Wings have been outscored 66-56, but only 41-37 at 5-on-5. On special teams, opponents have outscored them 20-11.

The Canucks (31st) and the Red Wings (30th) both ice the puck a lot. The Canucks have had shaky goaltending (32nd). They also have a leaky penalty kill (32nd), so the Wings’ power play (6th) could do real damage when they’re shorthanded. Vancouver has allowed 4.38 goals a game, the most in the league. As for the Red Wings, they block more shots than almost anyone (2nd) and take away shots from the point (4th lowest). Both teams play slow, low-event hockey, so expect a tight one.

Brock Boeser (8 G / 16 A / 24 P in 24 GP) leads the Canucks in scoring, with eight points in his last five games. Elias Pettersson (#40) (6 G / 17 A / 23 P in 24 GP) isn’t far behind. For the Red Wings, Lucas Raymond (9 G / 13 A / 22 P in 22 GP) leads the way in scoring, with a point in five straight games against Vancouver. Alex DeBrincat (7 G / 9 A / 16 P in 22 GP) isn’t far behind.

Leevi Meriläinen (3-10-1 / .889 SV% in 15 GS) will likely start for Vancouver. Detroit has two options in net: Daniil Tarasov (3-4-2 / .927 SV% in 8 GS) and John Gibson (4-7-1 / .862 SV% in 13 GS). They have split the last ten starts, and Tarasov got the last one on Nov 18. It’s anyone’s guess who gets the net.

The Canucks have been without Thatcher Demko all season. Leevi Meriläinen is expected to start.
Jake DeBrusk has six goals in nine games against Detroit since 2023-24.
Viktor Arvidsson has seven goals on chances worth about 10.5 goals, well below what his finishing usually turns chances into. If the chances keep coming, so should the goals.
